documents.title: Office Visit - Hypertension
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
BP f/u (vacation week). Losartan 50 + HCTZ 25. Home 130s-140s over 80s. Feels well; no headache, vision change, chest pain.
BP 146/88, HR 77, wt 70.3 kg. Heart regular. Lungs clear. Ankles without edema.
A/P: Renovascular HTN / R renal FMD — top of her usual range today, home log fine. Continue. BMP. Physical + co-test in October.

documents.author: MA
documents.body: Per PCP, BMP normal (K 4.1, Cr 0.67). Portal message sent.

documents.title: Mail-Order Prescriptions

documents.body: Pt's plan now requires maintenance meds through mail order for 90-day fills. New prescriptions sent to the mail-order pharmacy per PCP: losartan 50 mg daily #90 x3, hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily #90 x3. Local pharmacy asked to inactivate old refills. Pt aware.

reports.text:
SPECIMEN: Cervix, liquid-based preparation.
ADEQUACY: Satisfactory for evaluation; transformation zone component present.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL PHYSICAL
41 y/o F, well. Home BP 130s-140s/80s. No headaches, vision changes or tinnitus lately.
Meds: losartan 50 mg daily, hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily (mail order). NKDA.
Contraception reliable; ARB counselling repeated.

Prevention:
- Pap with HPV today (last 2019 normal).
- Flu today; updated COVID 10/5 at pharmacy (entered).
- Mammography: discussed again; she is still deciding.
- PHQ-2: 0.

Exam: BP 142/83, HR 86, T 36.5, SpO2 98%, wt 70.7 kg, BMI 25.7.
Well appearing. ENT normal. Thyroid normal. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Breasts without masses. Abdomen soft. Pelvic: external genitalia and vagina normal; cervix appears normal, co-test collected. No edema.

A/P
1. Renovascular HTN / R renal FMD — stable. Continue. BMP.
2. Health maintenance as above.

documents.title: Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Kristen — your Pap and HPV are normal again; next co-test in 5 years. Kidney function, potassium and sodium normal. Let me know if you decide about the mammogram and I'll put the order in.

documents.title: Home readings
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Happy new year! Sending my readings since Christmas since you asked last time: mostly 128 to 142 on top and 82 to 90 on the bottom. Feeling fine.

documents.title: RE: Home readings
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Thanks, Kristen — reviewed with the doctor. Those are in your usual range. No changes. See you in April.
